posts.author: Christoffer
posts.body:
RTP Heroes is a personal, passion project of mine that I've been slowly chipping away at since last year and it's finally gotten to the point where I feel comfortable enough to share my progress with others. As the title implies, the game will be based around the characters from the various versions of RPG Maker over the years. This is a growing, developing project that I hope I can share with others eventually! Without further ado, here are some information about my project.
The player begins the story as
Aldo
, who suddenly finds himself in a new, unknown land. With the last of her strength,
Buan
, the mighty Moon Goddess, explains to Aldo their new predicament. An unknown force has been slowly attacking universes, leaving them empty husks of their former selves. In a final effort to save who and what she could, the Moon Goddess transported Aldo and his allies to a universe protected by the Sun God,
Arau
. As Buan’s universe collapses, she gives Aldo his final mission: to live and preserve the memory of their universe, hoping that someday they can find a way to restore their home. However, it seems that Aldo and his allies were not the only ones who made it through...
The game is a story-based, classic turn-based RPG with several modifications. One key feature is the presence of a battle grid and unit types. Playable and non-playable characters are divided into three unit types: Vanguard, Midfield, and Rearguard. Each unit type has its own distinct strengths and weaknesses, which are explained in the spoiler below. Each team consists of three units, so it is up to the player to choose wisely who they bring into battle! Here is some information about the main trio of the story: Aldo, Nina, and Hayatemaru.
Spoiler
Another feature of RTP Heroes' gameplay is the shift toward a graphic-focused battle UI. Instead of scrolling through a list of skills, characters are limited to a handful of personalized abilities tailored to their element, movement type, and role. Here are some screenshots showing what an in-game battle looks like.
Spoiler
Hi there! My name's Christoffer and welcome to my devlog! I've been racking my brain trying to figure out how to do one of these because I've never thought I would get to this point where I have enough stuff to show off to anyone! If you happened to come across this thread, thank you for taking the time to read through to the end. As I mentioned in the beginning, this has been a passion project of mine for a while now and I'm just thrilled to finally show off some of what I've been working on.
I've always wondered what it would be like if the various heroes from the RPG Maker games met and what stories could be told from such scenario? And I guess the only way for me to satisfy that curiosity was to make it myself!
I have a LOT of work to get through still before I can comfortably release the game to the public but I will endeavour to work on it as much as I can (with what free time I have with my full time job) and hopefully release a playable demo sometime in 2025. But yeah, here is what I can share for now. Hopefully I manage to at least make someone smile, remembering the old (but not forgotten) characters of past RPG Makers.
Inside the spoiler are a couple more screenshots to show what the game would look like.

posts.author: Christoffer
posts.body:
First off, let me start by saying...
I assume most of the world has moved to the new year by now, or at least those who will see this message so, happy new year to everyone!
2024 had been a tough year personally, but it gave me a lot of time to re-evaluate my life and in that time I managed to make a lot of progress with RTP Heroes going from a mere concept to a playable walking simulator
(play tested by one of my best friends irl).
My main goal for 2025 is to eventually release a satisfactory demo to showcase the work put in this game, not just by myself but by others as well. I already have the main groundwork laid out on how I want this game to play (especially with the combat aspect) and the next year will be spent testing, analyzing, balancing and eventing (those cutscenes and action sequences don't make themselves!).
Over the next couple of... days, weeks, months...? I'll be posting updates whenever I can and introducing characters that you'll be able to interact with. One of which is that cute little guy up there named
SonSon
from the RPG Maker MZ Cover Art pack!
With that, let's get to the bulk of this post with some new information!
We'll start off by introducing three new allies you'll be able to recruit in the game!
Since I introduced 3 guys last time, it's only fair to introduce 3 girls this time! Other allies will be introduced as time goes on.
One main feature that I've been working on is called "Skill Link" which is a way for non-playable characters to help in battle. These are "skills" equippable via items & tokens given by characters by either completing their side quest, or via story progression.
There are two types of Skill Links; Support & Offense.
Since Ally characters have less skills than the main trio, they will be able to equip these Skill Links to help fill in the gap. Since
Nyphe
is an
Aether-attuned
witch, her attacks are normally Aether-typed. However, equipping
Kasey's Skill Link
will give her access to an offensive
Shadow
attack to increase her damage coverage!
Likewise, if someone would prefer to forego a healer in the party, they can equip
Rosa's Skill Link
which gives her access to a healing skill!
Spoiler:
Battle Images
Of course for balancing reasons, a character can only equip 1 of each type.
This hopefully gives people options on how they'd want to form their party since there will be several playable characters introduced in the game, instead of just playing with the initial trio (who, for balancing reasons, will NOT be able to access these Skill Links).
There is still a lot of work to be done before I can comfortably release a demo but I'm happy with how much I'm able to progress with development while working a full time job. Thank you for all those who showed me support, I really appreciate each and every one of you!
Another Dev Note should appear soon, to show off more... characters... but for now, some more screenshots featuring maps created by
@Ezclados
! As well as
@SangHendrix
's message bubble plugin which miraculously plays well with Visustella's MessageCore & Galv's busts plugin.
Spoiler:
Screenshots
That's all from me for now! Till the next update!

posts.author: Christoffer
posts.body:
​
Since I've introduced Heroes & Allies previously, I think it's only fair to introduce some Villains this time! They're from quite a range of sources but that's what makes a multiverse fun, right? Here are some Villainous characters for the RTP Heroes to clash against!
I've also been busy creating more maps, interiors this time! I've always liked it when you enter a new area and can just enter any house with a visible door so I've made it my mission to do exactly just that.
I totally do not regret that decision.
Between balancing my job and health issues, gamedev has slowed down and I've only been able to work on it when I can but at least it's moving along! I'm trying out Visustella's busts plugin and while it offers more features than Galv's plugin, boy does it require a lot more effort having to keep track of which picture is where but I'm still having fun and that's the main point isn't it?
Here are some screenshots and cameos from past RPG Maker characters I've implemented so far!

Till next time!
